data.name: Xenomire
data.detailed_description:
XENOMIRE is a 2D top-down sci-fi horror extraction shooter set on Vespera, a lost colony planet consumed by alien contamination.

As a government operative, you descend from the safety of an orbital station into hostile zones such as abandoned facilities, alien ruins filled with mutated lifeforms. Complete contracts, recover valuable resources, upgrade your gear, and extract before sleeping horrors wake up.

Every expedition is a high-risk decision. The longer you stay, the more aggressive the alien presence becomes. What begins as a quiet mission through dark corridors can spiral into a desperate fight for survival against monster swarms, ruthless mercenaries, and unstoppable horrors.

DESCEND, LOOT, EXTRACT

Choose a contract, prepare your loadout, and land on Vespera. Search the zone for supplies, complete objectives, and decide when to leave. Death means losing valuable resources, so every item, weapon, and upgrade matters.

SURVIVE AN ALIEN ECOSYSTEM

Vespera reacts to your presence. Time spent on the planet increase alien aggression, making each mission more dangerous the longer it continues. Don't overstay your welcome.

BUILD YOUR OPERATIVE

Collect dozens of weapons, customize them with powerful modules, and combine different armor sets with their own upgrades to create a build that fits your playstyle. Become a fast scout, a heavily armed gunner, a resilient scavenger, an aggressive exterminator, or anyone you desire. 

EXPLORE A DARK SCI-FI WORLD

Uncover what happened to the first colony, investigate alien ruins, and work with uneasy factions aboard the orbital station, each trying to exploit Vespera in their own way. Inspired by the oppressive tension of classic sci-fi horror, XENOMIRE blends extraction gameplay with atmosphere, mystery, and constant pressure.

FEATURES

  • 2D top-down PvE extraction shooter gameplay

  • Expeditions to a hostile alien planet

  • Loot, resources, gear upgrades, and build variety

  • Escalating alien aggression during each mission

  • Dark sci-fi horror atmosphere

  • Abandoned facilities, alien ruins, swarms, and powerful monstrosities

  • Orbital station hub with factions, preparation, and progression

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 900 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: XENOMIRE contains sci-fi horror violence, including combat with alien creatures and mutated enemies. Players use firearms and other weapons to fight monsters in dark, tense environments. The game may include non-realistic alien blood, unsettling creature designs, corpses, bones, and scenes of fear or distress. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, self-harm, or realistic human gore.
